author: Shafaet Brady Hussain
implementation: New dependency-free portable Node.js implementation, created with coding-assistant help. Original historical files listed here were reviewed for concepts; they are not included or copied wholesale.

concept_sources.concept: Bounded research, critic and final orchestration with source IDs
Deterministic routing and evidence-demand awareness; stale models and unvalidated numeric mixing are not carried over
Nine evidence-first research processes with source ledgers and validation checks
Local session and research-workspace workflows; legacy CLI, private configuration, account routes and experimental cipher are not bundled

included_data: One clearly labeled fictional research-note fixture and synthetic test strings only
claim_boundary: Software tests establish the tested workflow behavior, not scientific novelty, factual truth, AGI, independent cryptographic security, quantum advantage or independently audited research quality.
